_note: Base rates used in the outside view. Each entry: what the class is, the rate, how many cases, where it comes from. Update counts with every resolved claim (field 'own_record').

classes.description: European Parliament plenary adopts a provisional trilogue agreement put to a final vote
classes.n: large; failures are rare and usually signalled days ahead
classes.source: Legislative Observatory records, 9th and 10th terms (estimate pending a full count)

classes.description: A non-legislative resolution scheduled for a vote after a plenary debate is adopted that week
classes.source: Plenary minutes (estimate pending a full count); main risk is postponement

classes.description: Czech Chamber approves the state budget in first reading when the government holds a majority
classes.n: every budget since 1993 with a majority government
classes.source: psp.cz voting records; risk is timing (obstruction pushing the vote past the deadline)

classes.description: A ceasefire in the Russia-Ukraine war is announced within 48 hours of a US envoy meeting with Putin
classes.n: about 10 meetings 2025-2026, none followed by a ceasefire within 48 h

classes.description: Sakharov laureate is the finalist backed by the EPP
classes.n: roughly 10 years of decisions; EPP-backed finalist usually wins, sometimes jointly with an ECR or Renew candidate
classes.source: EP press releases 2015-2025 (estimate pending a full count)

classes.description: A US detainee in Russia is released during or within 48 hours of a US envoy visit to Moscow
An officially announced US–Iran agreement within 48 hours of a mediators’ proposal being delivered
A named pollster’s next runoff poll shows the two candidates within 2 points when the previous poll was within 2 points
A country with an active Ebola outbreak reports a confirmed count above a stated threshold within 48 hours
A second nationwide protest day without union backing draws fewer people than the first, by the Interior Ministry count
classes.source: Ministry counts reported by AFP/Le Monde (2018 gilets jaunes: 282,000 then 166,000)

classes.description: A Bulgarian presidential election goes to a second round
Prague Castle publishes the names of 28 October honours recipients four or more days before the ceremony
An unscheduled announcement or decision (date set, decree, levy, round of talks) is made within a one-day window
A scheduled statistical release (retail sales, PMI) comes in above a threshold near consensus
A central bank holds its rate when a hold is the consensus
A scheduled debate, poll publication or informal meeting takes place as planned (with no decisions where none are expected)
Czech Chamber: government bill clears or is stuck at a reading on the expected day, or reaches a stated vote count
Status quo holds for a protest alliance or a poll leader over one day
No poll published on a given day before an Israeli election gives either bloc 61 or more seats (Wikipedia government-parties column)
classes.n: small; October 2026 campaign polls, Channel 14 regularly shows the government bloc at 61+
classes.source: Wikipedia opinion polling table for the 2026 Israeli election (estimate pending a full count)

classes.description: The party or candidate leading the final pre-election polls wins the most votes or seats
classes.source: pipeline/reference-data/poll-error.json (national elections); own record adds local and provincial races

classes.description: A poll leader's final margin (or seat tally) clears a stated threshold beyond simply winning
classes.n: small; depends on lead vs threshold

classes.description: A named pollster's next poll shows a candidate strictly ahead when recent rounds were within 2 points
A leader appears in person at a scheduled public event (rally, summit) the day it is announced for
classes.source: News record (estimate pending a full count)

classes.description: A film festival's top award in a category goes to a film with a stated attribute (e.g. woman director)
classes.n: share of qualifying films in the competition

classes.description: A pollster with an irregular publication schedule publishes a new model in a given short window
A party leader who loses office in a general election announces resignation as leader on election night or the next day
classes.n: small; Canadian provincial and Westminster-system cases

classes.description: Turnout in an election exceeds the turnout of the previous comparable election
A candidate or list reaches a stated vote-share threshold in official results
Local or national coalition partners announce or sign an agreement within a window of one or two days
The loser of a presidential runoff publicly concedes or congratulates the winner within about a day of the result
classes.n: small; Latin American and European runoffs
classes.source: News record (estimate); own record from 27 Oct 2026

classes.description: A listed company's reported quarterly figure beats a consensus-based threshold
A fiscal measure widely trailed in the press before a budget statement is included in it
A specific contested person is named among state honours recipients
At least one dissent at a central-bank rate decision when dissent is signalled
A central bank moves its rate when markets price the move as likely
A defeated runoff candidate files a formal electoral contest within about two days
